payload.title: Deploy p.apyr.us with Prospectus sign-in
payload.description:
Hand-off from the Prospectus integration thread (PPY-58f107) to the DevOps session. Not deployed from the Mac; use the pipeline.

Facts: AWS profile papyrus-production, account 712236451410, p.apyr.us Amplify app ds6yswxui41yi, user pool us-east-1_1sQaEOwsH, Prospectus accounts API bnh9mctvo9 stage api.

Steps
1. In AnthusAI/p.apyr.us bump @anthusai/papyrus and infra/site.json papyrusVersion to exactly 1.0.0-next.64. Only next.64 contains PR 220; not next.63 and not v1.0.0.
2. Set cms.prospectusAccountsApiStageArn to arn:aws:execute-api:us-east-1:712236451410:bnh9mctvo9/api and update stack amplify-app-shell-p-apyr-us-cms.
3. Run a backend deploy so the prospectus-google-only Cognito client exists.
4. Report back: CmsComputeRoleArn, pool id, ProspectusGoogleOnlyClientId, ProspectusGoogleOnlyIssuer.

Cautions
- Cognito domain papyrus-p-apyr-us must stay unchanged.
- Prospectus's own Amplify backend stack is in UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE; flag to its owner, do not touch it.

After the deploy the Prospectus thread files the p.apyr.us entry in accounts/papyrus-sites.json via kanbus-2755969c with two Papyrus-minted review IDs, then wires account selection into the live curation host.
